# File-level Overview

This document provides a high-level summary of the key files and directories in the `code_agent` repository. Each module's public API is documented at its top level (docstrings). For more details, see [CODE_AGENT](./CODE_AGENT.qmd), [API Reference](./API.qmd) or the respective package headers.

## Core Package Structure

| File / Directory               | Purpose                                                                                   | Key Functions / Components                                                    |
|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/__init__.py`       | **Package entry point** - exports public API                                              | All core functions & classes listed in [`__all__`](../code_agent/__init__.py) |
| `code_agent/cli.py`            | Typer-based command-line interface.                                                       | `app`, `serve`, `chat`, `scaffold` commands                                   |
| `code_agent/main.py`           | Library helpers for LLM configuration                                                     | [`load_config()`](../code_agent/main.py), [`create_llm()`]()                  |
| `code_agent/settings.py`       | Pydantic Settings model with `.env` override support.                                     | [`Settings`](settings), [`get_settings()`]                                    |
| `../code_agent/utils/graph.py` | LangGraph StateGraph for agent orchestration (deprecated, migrating to LangChain harness) | Legacy graph builder                                                          |
| `code_agent/scaffold.py`       | Project skeleton generator with template support.                                         | [`create_project_scaffold()`]()                                               |
| `code_agent/tools/_io.py`      | Atomic file I/O utilities for agent tools.                                                | [`_atomic_write()`, `create_from_template()`, `FileObject`]                   |
| `code_agent/exceptions.py`     | Custom exception types for error handling                                                 | [`CodeAgentError`](exceptions), [`FileCreationError`](exceptions)             |

## Agent Layer

| File / Directory                        | Purpose                         | Key Functions / Components                                                       |
|-----------------------------------------|---------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/agents/base_agent.py`       | Base agent class & tool factory | [`build_agent()`](../code_agent/agents), create_default_tools(), PersistentAgent |
| `code_agent/agents/persistent_agent.py` | Agent with session persistence  | Stateful agents, memory management                                               |

## Capabilities Layer (OAP-inspired)

The capabilities layer provides an audit trail for all agent actions via hash-chained receipts. Each action is wrapped
in a capability envelope (`InvocationRequest`, `InvocationResponse`) before execution.

| File / Directory                          | Purpose                                       | Key Functions / Components                                                     |
|-------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/capabilities/base.py`         | Capability protocol definitions               | [`Capability`](capabilities), [`CapabilitiesBase`](capabilities)               |
| `code_agent/capabilities/audit.py`        | Audit logging with hash-chain receipts        | [`AuditLog`](capibilities.audit), [`Receipt`](capabilities.audity)             |
| `code_agent/capabilities/envelope.py`     | Request/response envelopes for capabilities   | [`InvocationRequest`](envelopes), [`InvocationResponse`](envelopes)            |
| `code_agent/capabilities/registry.py`     | Tool discovery & dispatch registry            | [`CapabilityRegistry`](capabilities.registry), [tool_to_capability()](regisry) |
| `code_agent/capabilities/tool_adapter.py` | Adapts LangChain tools to capability protocol | tool adapter, validation                                                       |

## Tools Layer

Tools are BaseTool subclasses that interact with the filesystem or environment. See [`TOOLS.qmd`](./TOOLS.qmd) for detailed descriptions of each tool's capabilities and usage patterns.

| File / Directory    | Purpose                            | Key Functions / Components                                                                 |
|---------------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/tools/` | LangChain BaseTool implementations | All tools inherit from [`BaseTool`](https://python.langchain.com/docs/concepts/#base-tool) |

## Providers Layer

The provider layer enables model swapping without changing agent logic. See [API Reference](./API.qmd#provider-layer) for usage details.

| File / Directory                  | Purpose                                        | Key Functions / Components                                       |
|-----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/providers/base.py`    | Provider protocol definitions                  | [`LLMProvider`](providers.base), [ProvidersBase](providers.base) |
| `code_agent/providers/factory.py` | Factory for creating providers based on config | create_provider()                                                |
| `code_agent/providers/ollama.py`  | Ollama model provider                          | OllamaModel, ChatOllama                                          |
| `code_agent/providers/openai.py`  | OpenAI API provider                            | OpenAIClient, ChatOpenAI                                         |

## UI Layer

| File / Directory       | Purpose                           | Key Functions / Components                            |
|------------------------|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| `code_agent/ui/web.py` | FastAPI backend for web interface | [`app`](ui.web), `/capabilities`, `/invoke` endpoints |

## Documentation & Build

| File / Directory                 | Purpose                           | Key Functions / Components   |
|----------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------------------------|
| `docs/`                          | Quarto documentation source files | Source `.qmd/.md` docs       |
| `_quarto.yml`                    | Quarto project configuration      | Website, PDF output settings |
| `CHANGELOG.qmd`, `FAQ.qmd`, etc. | User-facing guides                | -                            |

## Testing

| File / Directory | Purpose                           | Key Functions / Components                          |
|------------------|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `tests/`         | Pytest unit and integration tests | ~103 test cases covering agents, tools, scaffolding |

**Note:** The agent is currently in alpha (v0.1.0) and actively migrating from custom StateGraph to LangChain's built-in harness for better reliability.
